what: Extract Tox Info from Various Databases
title: Extract Tox Info from Various Databases
text: extractox comprehensive R package designed simplify querying various chemical, toxicological, biological databases: Integrated Chemical Environment (ICE) National Toxicology Program (NTP). Integrated Risk Information System (IRIS) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Provisional Peer-Reviewed Toxicity Values (PPRTVs) EPA. Computational Toxicology Chemicals Dashboard Resource Hub (CompTox) EPA, monographs International Agency Research Cancer World Health Organization (). PubChem National Center Biotechnology Information/National Institutes Health (NCBI, NIH). package facilitates interaction APIs, providing curated user-friendly outputs. communicate Pubchem, extractox relies packagewebchem.

title: Extract Tox Info from Various Databases
text: ICE database provides access variety data related chemical toxicity, exposure, risk assessment. includes data high-throughput screening assays, vivo studies, computational models. extr_ice provides access NTP’s ICE database toxicological exposure-related data. 2000 possible assays ICE. extr_ice_assay_names() function allows search assay names match pattern ’re interested . Please note searches case sensitive accept regexp.
code: library(extractox) # assays is null so all assays are retrieved ice_data <- extr_ice(casrn = c("50-00-0"), assays = NULL, verbose = FALSE) names(ice_data)  #>  [1] "assay"                 "endpoint"              "substance_type"        #>  [4] "casrn"                 "qsar_ready_id"         "value"                 #>  [7] "unit"                  "species"               "receptor_species"      #> [10] "route"                 "sex"                   "strain"                #> [13] "life_stage"            "tissue"                "lesion"                #> [16] "location"              "assay_source"          "in_vitro_assay_format" #> [19] "reference"             "reference_url"         "dtxsid"                #> [22] "substance_name"        "pubmed_id"             "query" extr_ice_assay_names("Rat Acute", verbose = FALSE) # keep empty to retrieve all  #> [1] "Rat Acute Oral Toxicity"         "Rat Acute Inhalation Toxicity"   #> [3] "Rat Acute Dermal Toxicity"       "CATMoS, Rat Acute Oral Toxicity"

what: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
title: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
text: function takes vector IUPAC names queries PubChem database (using webchem package) obtain corresponding CASRN CID compound. reshapes resulting data, ensuring compound unique row CID, CASRN, additional chemical properties.

title: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
code: extr_chem_info(iupac_names, verbose = TRUE, domain = "compound", delay = 0)

title: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
text: iupac_names character vector IUPAC names. standardized names chemical compounds used search PubChem database. verbose logical value indicating whether print detailed messages. Default TRUE. domain character string specifying PubChem domain query. One "compound" substance. Default compound. delay numeric value indicating delay (seconds) API requests. controls time successive PubChem queries. Default 0. See Details info.

title: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
text: data frame phisio-chemical information queried compounds, including limited : iupac_name IUPAC name compound. cid PubChem Compound Identifier (CID). isomeric_smiles SMILES string (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System).

title: Query Chemical Information from IUPAC Names — extr_chem_info
text: function performs two queries PubChem: first query retrieves PubChem Compound Identifier (CID) IUPAC name. second query retrieves additional information using obtained CIDs. cases multiple rapid successive requests, PubChem server may deny access. Introducing delay requests (using delay parameter) can help prevent issue.

title: Download and Extract Data from CompTox Chemistry Dashboard — extr_comptox
text: ids character vector containing items searched within CompTox Chemistry Dashboard. can chemical names, CAS Registry Numbers (CASRN), InChIKeys, DSSTox substance identifiers (DTXSID). download_items character vector items downloaded. includes comprehensive set chemical properties, identifiers, predictive data, relevant information. Default, downloads info. CASRN Chemical Abstracts Service Registry Number, unique numerical identifier chemical substances. INCHIKEY hashed version full International Chemical Identifier (InChI) string. IUPAC_NAME International Union Pure Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) name chemical. SMILES Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System (SMILES) representation chemical structure. INCHI_STRING full International Chemical Identifier (InChI) string. MS_READY_SMILES SMILES representation chemical structure, prepared mass spectrometry analysis. QSAR_READY_SMILES SMILES representation chemical structure, prepared quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) modeling. MOLECULAR_FORMULA chemical formula representing number type atoms molecule. AVERAGE_MASS average mass molecule, calculated based isotopic distribution elements. MONOISOTOPIC_MASS mass molecule calculated using abundant isotope element. QC_LEVEL quality control level data. SAFETY_DATA Safety information related chemical. EXPOCAST Exposure predictions EPA's ExpoCast program. DATA_SOURCES Sources data provided. TOXVAL_DATA Toxicological values related chemical. NUMBER_OF_PUBMED_ARTICLES number articles related chemical PubMed. PUBCHEM_DATA_SOURCES Sources data PubChem. CPDAT_COUNT number entries Chemical Product Categories Database (CPDat). IRIS_LINK Link EPA's Integrated Risk Information System (IRIS) entry chemical. PPRTV_LINK Link EPA's Provisional Peer-Reviewed Toxicity Values (PPRTV) entry chemical. WIKIPEDIA_ARTICLE Link Wikipedia article chemical. QC_NOTES Notes related quality control data. ABSTRACT_SHIFTER Information related abstract shifter. TOXPRINT_FINGERPRINT ToxPrint chemoinformatics fingerprint chemical. ACTOR_REPORT Aggregated Computational Toxicology Resource (ACTOR) report chemical. SYNONYM_IDENTIFIER Identifiers synonyms chemical. RELATED_RELATIONSHIP Information related chemicals. ASSOCIATED_TOXCAST_ASSAYS Assays associated chemical ToxCast database. TOXVAL_DETAILS Details toxicological values. CHEMICAL_PROPERTIES_DETAILS Details chemical properties. BIOCONCENTRATION_FACTOR_TEST_PRED Predicted bioconcentration factor tests. BOILING_POINT_DEGC_TEST_PRED Predicted boiling point degrees Celsius tests. 48HR_DAPHNIA_LC50_MOL/L_TEST_PRED Predicted 48-hour LC50 Daphnia mol/L tests. DENSITY_G/CM^3_TEST_PRED Predicted density g/cm³ tests. DEVTOX_TEST_PRED Predicted developmental toxicity tests. 96HR_FATHEAD_MINNOW_MOL/L_TEST_PRED Predicted 96-hour LC50 fathead minnow mol/L tests. FLASH_POINT_DEGC_TEST_PRED Predicted flash point degrees Celsius tests. MELTING_POINT_DEGC_TEST_PRED Predicted melting point degrees Celsius tests. AMES_MUTAGENICITY_TEST_PRED Predicted Ames mutagenicity tests. ORAL_RAT_LD50_MOL/KG_TEST_PRED Predicted oral LD50 rats mol/kg tests. SURFACE_TENSION_DYN/CM_TEST_PRED Predicted surface tension dyn/cm tests. THERMAL_CONDUCTIVITY_MW_M×K_TEST_PRED Predicted thermal conductivity mW/m×K tests. TETRAHYMENA_PYRIFORMIS_IGC50_MOL/L_TEST_PRED Predicted IGC50 Tetrahymena pyriformis mol/L tests. VISCOSITY_CP_CP_TEST_PRED Predicted viscosity cP tests. BIOCONCENTRATION_FACTOR_OPERA_PRED Predicted bioconcentration factor OPERA. BIODEGRADATION_HALF_LIFE_DAYS_DAYS_OPERA_PRED Predicted biodegradation # nolint half-life days OPERA. title: Extract Assay Names from the ICE Database — extr_ice_assay_names
text: function allows users search assay names ICE database using regular expression. search pattern provided (regex = NULL), returns available assay names.

title: Extract FEMA from PubChem — extr_pubchem_fema

title: Extract FEMA from PubChem — extr_pubchem_fema

title: Extract FEMA from PubChem — extr_pubchem_fema
text: casrn vector CAS Registry Numbers (CASRN) atomic vectors. verbose logical value indicating whether print detailed messages. Default TRUE. delay numeric value indicating delay (seconds) API requests. controls time successive PubChem queries. Default 0. See Details info.

title: Extract FEMA from PubChem — extr_pubchem_fema
text: data frame containing FEMA flavor profile information CASRN. information found particular CASRN, output include row indicating .

title: Extract FEMA from PubChem — extr_pubchem_fema
text: function performs two queries PubChem: first query retrieves PubChem Compound Identifier (CID) IUPAC name. second query retrieves additional information using obtained CIDs. cases multiple rapid successive requests, PubChem server may deny access. what: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
title: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
text: wrapper function retrieves toxicological information specified chemicals calling several external functions query multiple databases, including PubChem, Integrated Chemical Environment (ICE), CompTox Chemicals Dashboard, Integrated Risk Information System (IRIS) .

title: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
code: extr_tox(casrn, verbose = TRUE, force = TRUE, delay = 2)

title: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
text: casrn character vector CAS Registry Numbers (CASRN) representing chemicals interest. verbose logical value indicating whether print detailed messages. Default TRUE. force Logical indicating whether force fresh download EPA PPRTV database. Default TRUE. delay Numeric value indicating delay seconds requests avoid overwhelming server. Default 3 seconds.

title: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
text: list data frames containing toxicological information retrieved database: who_iarc_monographs Lists , IARC monographs related chemical. pprtv Risk assessment data EPA PPRTV ghs_dat Toxicity data PubChem's Globally Harmonized System (GHS) classification. ice_dat Assay data Integrated Chemical Environment (ICE) database. iris Risk assessment data IRIS database. comptox_list List dataframe toxicity information CompTox Chemicals Dashboard.

title: Extract Toxicological Information from Multiple Databases — extr_tox
text: Specifically, function: Calls extr_monograph return monographs informations IARC. Calls extr_pubchem_ghs retrieve GHS classification data PubChem. Calls extr_ice gather assay data ICE database. Calls extr_iris retrieve risk assessment information IRIS database. Calls extr_comptox retrieve data CompTox Chemicals Dashboard.

title: extractox 1.2.1
text: extr_ctd extr_tetramer removed package. CTD website now requires ALTCHA CAPTCHA challenge prevents automated API access. related source, documentation, tests deleted.

title: extractox 1.2.1
text: Graceful exit error: exported HTTP-facing functions (extr_comptox, extr_ice, extr_iris, extr_pprtv, extr_casrn_from_cid, extr_chem_info, extr_pubchem_fema, extr_pubchem_ghs) now return NULL cli::cli_warn() message failure instead throwing error. implemented via new internal helper with_graceful_exit(). Jittered exponential backoff: httr2 requests now use req_retry(max_tries = 5, backoff = httr2_backoff) jittered exponential backoff strategy (capped 30 s, ±20% jitter). condathis/curl code paths use equivalent condathis_run_retry() helper.

title: extractox 1.2.1
text: Fixed condathis::run() calls extr_comptox_openssl_() extr_iris_openssl_(): errors now caught via tryCatch re-thrown clear message rather causing uncontrolled crash. Fixed extr_chem_info: now aborts informative message PubChem returns empty response, rather failing silently downstream. Fixed httr2_backoff() function signature match single-argument backoff callback contract required httr2::req_retry(). Restored correct CompTox batch export endpoint URL extr_comptox_out(). Fixed typo (s. → .) DESCRIPTION field (#50). Updated test expectations extr_ice extr_casrn_from_cid match current upstream API response sizes. Updated extr_comptox tests reflect CompTox API change: comptox_main_data now returns 63 columns instead 64. Updated extr_casrn_from_cid test reflect current PubChem data (row count updated 42 29). Fixed extr_tox test: replaced incorrect expect_no_warning() suppressWarnings(); function intentionally warns via with_graceful_exit() individual sub-service (e.g. ICE) fails transiently. data.frame check now resilient NULL elements transiently unavailable services. Fixed extr_monograph test: corrected expect() call expect_equal() checking count missing values. Added missing skip_on_cran() skip_if_offline() guards extr_monograph tests make live API calls. Renamed test file test_monograph.R test-monograph.R follow test-*.R convention required automatic discovery testthat.

title: extractox 1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2025-07-15

title: extractox 1.2.0
text: Automated Server Compatibility: Functions connecting EPA servers (e.g., extr_comptox, extr_iris, extr_pprtv) now automatically handle connection issues can occur systems modern libcurl OpenSSL. functions detect problematic configurations use condathis package perform requests compatible version curl isolated environment. ensures reliability without requiring manual user intervention.

title: extractox 1.2.0
text: extr_chem_info now accepts argument domain specify PubChem domain (substance compound). extr_tox now accepts delay parameter control delay requests, helping avoid rate-limiting errors. Request Throttling**: Added delay parameter PubChem functions allow pause requests, helping avoid rate-limiting errors. Verbose Option: verbose option added several functions detailed output execution.

title: extractox 1.2.0
text: Testing: Corrected various tests, including fix incorrect row count expectation PubChem test. Fixed extr_chem_info duplicated name outout columns (#47). Function Cleanup: Refined extr_comptox function, removing unnecessary requirements cleaning code.

title: extractox 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2025-01-07

title: extractox 1.0.0
text: Fixed extr_iris extracting correct number chemicals without repetition (#15). Fixed extr_comtox working single download_items different DTXCID selected (#17). Fixed extr_casrn_from_cid failure results found.

title: extractox 1.0.0
text: Added extr_ice_assay_names retrieve ICE assay names (#16). Added extr_monograph check substance listed IARC monograph return details (#19). Added extr_pprtv extract information EPA Provisional Peer-Reviewed Toxicity Values database (#20). Introduced save_to_cache load_from_cache functions avoid re-downloading file time. See force argument.

title: extractox 1.0.0
text: Removed cancer_types argument extr_iris. Database returns dataframe different columns based request arguments. Removed stop_at_warning argument extr_casrn_from_cid. Now warns returns dataframe NA IDs found. extr_tox now returns longer list dataframes, including outputs extr_monograph extr_pprtv.

title: extractox 1.0.0
text: Added verbose argument extr_ functions (#18). functions except extr_comptox, query column reports IDs searched. extr_comptox, info main_sheet element. extr_ice, query values contain IDs found. Results now contain rows NA values columns (except query). extr_pprtv extr_monograph use save_and_match output results NA missing IDs. Improved extended unit tests. extr_comptox now outputs list dataframes clean names. Fixed extr_ctd column names: pub_med_ids pub_med_i_ds now pubmed_ids. Introduced extr_pubchem_section_ internal function fetch FEMA GHS info, avoiding repeated code. Introduced check_na_warn internal function generate warnings missing IDs. Created with_extr_sandbox handle cache CRAN examples.
